name: Feature request
about: Suggest a focused improvement to ScopeTrace.
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

English and Russian proposals are welcome. Do not include secrets or private source code.

## Problem

What task is difficult today? Include a concrete use case.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the user-facing result, CLI interaction, and example output when relevant.

## Alternatives

What alternatives or workarounds have you considered?

## Analysis and safety

Could the change introduce uncertain scope requirements, new token models, network access, code execution, or sensitive report data? Explain the expected boundaries.

## Additional context

Link to relevant official documentation or related issues.

## Checks

- [ ] I searched existing issues.
- [ ] I read the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/sinzbtw/scopetrace/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
